statement: For eta9/25,p2^-256,F_eta(e)=g(eta e)+7e is a global increasing concave upper independent of Gaussian helper seed/energy; whitening cost and Jensen handle squeezing,arbitrary bursting,time sharing/closure. Accepted e18 parallel Holevo further covers mixed/use-entangled Gaussian helper BLOCK states and revealed-label convex mixtures,even arbitrary nonGaussian signal codes; message-dependent basis is only a conditional converse,not sender advice.
